hospital_coding_system_help: Binds this hospital to one diagnosis code catalogue (WHO ICD-10, US ICD-10-CM, or WHO ICD-11). Cannot change after coded diagnoses exist.

icd_who_attribution: ICD-10 and ICD-11 content is copyright World Health Organization (WHO). ICD-11 is licensed under CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Use requires attribution; adaptations need WHO permission.
docs_coding_standards_body: Each hospital binds one diagnosis coding catalogue (WHO ICD-10, US ICD-10-CM, or WHO ICD-11 MMS) at create time. EMR diagnosis search uses that catalog only. WHO catalogs import via WHO ICD-API; ICD-10-CM imports from CDC code description files. Each edition stays in its own system column.

prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Huutortee ko nde sosde jamirooje sarwiis. Fotde gonnde e YY/njillu/NNN. Sokkit “Sequence separate par visite” ngam limooje yamiroore limtee 001, 002... e kala njillu ñawɗo (wasiyaa). So tawii ko nde udditaa, doggol ngol renndintee ko e denndaangal jamirooje kuutortooɗe kuutorɗe njuɓɓudi goɗɗe goote.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Huutortee ko nde sosde ɗaɓɓaande coodgu (PR). Konfiguur ɗum hade gollotooɓe waawde sosde PRs.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Huutortee ko nde sosde yamiroore coodgu (PO). Konfiguur ɗum ko adii nde gollotooɓe mbaawata sosde POs.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Huutortee ko nde sosde indents departemaa. Konfiguur ɗum hade gollotooɓe sosde indents.

prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Huutortee ko nde rokkata kaayitaaji njaru departemaa ngam jaɓeede.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Huutortee ko nde hisnata jamirooje leɗɗe nder. Denndaangal diidi e nder save gooto ina ndennda ndee limoore batch. Default huutortoo ko hitaande kaalis, opitaal, e doggol dogdu.

Kala diidi: poLineId, soodaamaQty (ina heen ko yoɓaaka), batchNo, Ñalngu timmuɗo, Coodgu coodgu (ina ɗaɓɓi so huunde ina jogii rewindaade batte). Batte ɗee ko no woorunoo (item_batte); restoraaji ko restoraaji kala e batte (inv_restoraaji).

inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Njeñtudi njiylawu ina waɗi e junngo e nder defterdu cuɓaandu (gila) tan (unit issue so ina woodi).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: View ina uddita ndeeɗoo keɓrugol e hello mum; Back warti ɗoo (wonaa e haala Departemaa).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Rogereeji ɗii ko `inv_stock` jokkondirɗi e `item_batch`, yamiraaɗi e timmal (FEFO).

inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: PR, PO, e GRN ngam marsandiis coodaaɗo ina kuutoroo ndeeɗoo defterdu. Magasin cuɓaaɗo oo ina maantiniree coodgu Catal ; ko adii koo ina hoota e Regular.
inv_pr_trace_hint: So doggol ina timmi e yamiroore (yamiroore) coodgu, keewal udditiingal ko 0 ɗoo; rewindaade yamiraama, keɓaa, e haa jooni ina jogori heɓde e ekranuuji PO e GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Yamiroore coodgu ina woodi ngam ooɗoo PR kono doggol ngol waawaa loowde. Enndu hesɗitinde hello ngoo.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Bar dow oo ina setti innde maa / ɗaɓɓoowo (e) defterdu. Doggol ngol ina hollita ɗaɓɓaaɗe ɗe oon magasin ummini. Suɓo Denndaangal defte ngam yiyde ɗaɓɓaaɗe ummoraade e kala defte ɗaɓɓoowo, walla huutoro filtirde koloñaal defte ngam ustude e Gila e defte.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Stock ina fawii e magasin e nder bar toowɗo. Suɓo Denndaangal defte ngam yiyde kala defte e nder safrirde.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Doggol ngol ina fawii e indents ɗi magasin oo ummini e nder bar toowɗo oo. Suɓo Denndaangal defte ngam yiyde denndaangal nate departemaaji.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Sosde ɗaɓɓaande coodgu e nder defterdu ɗaɓɓoowo (bar dow) → caggal jaɓgol, sos yamiroore coodgu e jokkude GRN e nder defterdu keɓoowo → e doggol GRN, huutoraade Transfer ngam nawde stock keɓaaɗo to defterdu udditirndu ɗaɓɓaande ndee (so PR jokkondirii e PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Gila store ummorii ko e bar dow. Suɓo a To store ngam ndee ɗaɓɓaande.
inv_flow_po_context: POs ngam defterdu cuɓaandu (bar dow) ina njokki e ɗaɓɓaande coodgu jaɓaande walla naatgol e junngo ; jaɓde caggal ɗuum neldu to supplier ko adii nde marsandiis oo heɓata.
inv_flow_grn_context: Posto resiltaaji e nder defterdu jaɓɓordu (bar dow). So PO jokkondirii e ɗaɓɓaande, huutoro Transfer ngam neldude stock to magasin ɗaɓɓoowo caggal nde njolnu-ɗaa GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Suɓo yeeyirde e nder barme dow ngam tiiɗtinde ndee doggol, walla huutoro Denndaangal yamiroore coodgu e nder safrirde nde yeeyirde wootere suɓaaka.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Magasin hakkundeejo (bar dow = Gila e magasin) ina ummina caɗeele e magasinuuji ɗaɓɓooɓe: maa ummoraade e indent departemaa jaɓaaɗo ina fadi timmal, walla e junngo tawa indent alaa.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Hono yamiroore coodgu: huutoroo Keso ummoraade e departemaa indent so tawii restoraaji ina ɗaɓɓiree to magasin maa hakkundeejo rewrude e indent; huutoro Manual nde innde alaa.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Waylu “From store” ɗowgol e nder barme dow (sara cakkital / fedde kuutortooɗo) so taƴre Inventory udditaama.
inv_dept_issue_no_pending_indents: Alaa indents ina ɗaminii ndeeɗoo defterdu.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Ɗee inndeeji njaɓaama e defterdu ɗaɓɓoowo, ina ɗaminii ma udditde tonngoode departemaa. Suɓo defterdu hakkundeeru e nder barme dow.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Sos haala departemaa ummoraade e Inventory → Haala departemaa → Keso ummoraade e indent departemaa (magasin hakkundeejo ina foti yahdude e magasin “to” indent oo e nder bar dow).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Suɓo defterdu hakkundeeru (fulfulde) e nder barme dow. Doggol ngol hollirta ko geɗe ɗo oon defterdu woni yaltinoowo (From).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Jaɓ keɓgol e nder defterdu maa ɗaɓɓoowo (gila e bar). Indents yaltinaaɗi ina peeña ɗoo haa keɓaa.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Suɓo yeeyirde maa ɗaɓɓoowo e nder barme dow ngam limtude nate ɗaɓɓooje keɓgol e ndeen yeeyirde.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Kuutoragol winndu e nder defterdu tawa ina waɗi ustaare to bannge batch. Waɗde ngam jaɓeede; jaɓgol timmungol postooji ñaamde e ustude restoraaji.

med_order_int_starts_staggered_toast: Waktuuji puɗɗagol ina njokki e doggol diidi. Kala doggol fuɗɗotoo ko caggal nde doggol ɓennungol ngol timmi. Keewgol e doseeji ɗii mbaylaaka.

home_inv_dashboard_stock_alerts_hint: Limlebbi ɗii ina mbaɗi tan ko defte e nder caɗeele cuɓaaɗe maa. Jeertinaango e iimeeluuji nder app ina neldee e kala defterdu mo abonmaa, e seertude ngam lowre lowre vs joofnde ko ɓooyaani (ɓeydu kala defterdu e les njuɓɓudi Inventory → Jeertinaango lowre).

inv_stock_alert_policy_hint: Windooji timmuɗi kala huunde ina mbaawi waɗeede e Item Master (ina ɓura default opitaal les oo).
inv_stock_alert_policy_email_channels: Jeertinaali nder app ina njokki e kaayitaaji Keɓooɓe tan. Ngam heɓde iimeeluuji kadi, udditu kala sifaa jeertinaango ɗoo (hisnaa), yuɓɓin SMTP e serveer oo, kadi ƴeewto kala golloowo Better Auth login ina jogii adrees imeel.

inv_stock_alert_invalid_gap: Hojomaaji coofɗi ina poti wonde ko famɗi fof 1.

Huutoro kaayitaaji Low stock / Expiring ko ɓooyaani e kala rowre; Policy ina jogii kadi mbayliigu imeel ceertuɗo. Ko gollotooɓe toɗɗaaɓe e opitaal tan mbaawi ɓeydeede heen.
inv_stock_alert_recipient_exists: Oon golloowo ina limtaa tawo ngam ndeeɗoo defterdu.
inv_stock_alert_cron_body: Ngam heɓde jeertinaango e iimeel e sahaa, noddu ndeeɗoo toɓɓere joofnirde e doggol (yeru kala hojomaaji 15). Huutoro email=1 tan so SMTP ina njuɓɓinee.
inv_stock_alert_cron_secret: Neldu hoore Jaɓde: Jogiiɗo <CRON_SECRET> walla x-cron-sirru. Seŋo CRON_SECRET e nder nokku serwer.

home_seo_title: Menziiji Medora | Golle safrirde calminaaɗe wonande kala ekipaaji toppitiiɗi
home_seo_description: Medora ko EMR mo opitaaluuji keewɗi ngam winnditaade, njilluuji, golle kilinik, limto, e njuɓɓudi. Konsol Medora gooto wonande joom en, gollotooɓe, e dowri toppitiindi.
home_hero_headline: Waylu balɗe safrirde ɗee e dogdu calminaandu, jokkondirndu
home_hero_body: Medora: golle toppitiiɗe opitaaluuji keewɗi e binnditagol, njilluuji, nokkuuji gollorɗi kilinik, e innde e nder konsol loyndotooɗo gooto.
home_how_heading: Gila e binnditagol haa e njillu udditiingu
home_how_lead: Flow gooto ngam walk-ins e toppitagol booked. Mahi ngam wakkatiiji ekipaaji tigi rigi move ñawɓe.
home_how_step1_body: Nanngu anndinde, alerji, e daartol laawol gootol. Kala njillu caggal ina huutoroo kartal gootal.
home_how_step2_body: Sos njilluuji OP walla IP, jokkondir e jokkondire, e jogaade konngol branch laaɓtungol ngam haala.
home_how_step3_body: Nursing vitals, diagnostics, jamirooje leɗɗe, e binndanɗe ina nguuri e sahaa njillu gooto.
home_how_step4_body: Caɗeele binnditagol, jokkondire faktiir, e laabi udditgol ina keddii e jokkondirde e winndannde njillu.
home_modules_heading: Mahi ngam ñalawma opitaal oo fof
home_modules_lead: Paɗe mbaawkaaji ina kuutoroo birooji ɗi foti wonde e sinkron: birooji yeeso, etaaji kilinik, defte, e admin.
home_modules_registration_body: Jaagorɗo muñɗo, tafngo njillu, jokkondire, e ƴeewndo-annduɗo calɗi.
home_modules_clinical_body: Module infirmiyee e konsultaasiyoŋ e vital, diagnostic, jamirooje, e note EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Magasinuuji, batte, PR/PO/GRN, njaru departemaaji, e jeertinaango magasin.
home_modules_admin_body: Gollotooɓe, caɗeele, pelle kuutortooɗe, jaagorgal, binndanɗe, e njuɓɓudi opitaal.
home_model_heading: SaaS gooto. Opitaaluuji keewɗi. Darnde laaɓtunde.
home_model_lead: Medora ko opitaal keewɗo e diisnondiral. Plateau oo ina sosa opitaal oo. Opitaal oo ina doga toppitagol. Ñawɓe meeɗaa haajuuji biro maa caggal.
home_model_platform_body: Siistem admins jom aawdiiji, opitaaluuji, e gardeeji kala jom suudu renndini.
home_model_hospital_body: Joom en e ardiiɓe ina njuɓɓina caɗeele, defte, jokkondire gollotooɓe, e joom en jawɗeele en.
home_model_staff_body: Infirmier en, safrooɓe, e ekipaaji magasin ina ngolloo gila e module role-aware e dow leydi.
home_model_patients_body: Karte, njilluuji, e kaayitaaji ina keddii e safrirde ndee ; gollotooɓe ina kuutoroo gila e konsol.
home_surfaces_heading: Surfaces ngam kala darnde e dow leydi
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Vitals, allergies, notes infirmières, e golle leeso tawa yaltaani njillu nguu.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Diagnostics, jamirooje leɗɗe, e binndanɗe safaara ngam biro doktoor.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Jaɓde, yaltinnde, nawde, e ƴeewtaade kaɓirɗe e humpito batch e timmoode.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Gollotooɓe, caɗeele, pelle jokkondire, joom en binndanɗe, e konfiguraasiyoŋ.
home_integrated_heading: Waɗde kala biro e limto waktu gooto
home_integrated_lead: Toɗɗagol, leɗɗe, binndanɗe, e dille stock ina ndennda njillu nguu mbele haala ina heddoo e mbaydi.
home_cta_body: Naat e konsol Medora, suɓo opitaal, puɗɗo-ɗaa e moodule ɗe ekipaaji maa kuutortoo jooni ɗii.
home_footer_tagline: Golle opitaal ngam winnditaade, toppitaade safaara, limtude, e njuɓɓudi.
home_scene_aria: Medora kollirgol opitaal sara leɗɗe e nder galle caliiɗo
pricing_seo_description: Coodgu EMR opitaal Medora: Duule gila e $99/mo (Fuɗɗorde haa e Platform). On-premise huutortoo ko tiers gooti e coggu Cloud + $150/mo ngam udditde e lowre maa. Binnditagol, kilinik, limto, e admin.
pricing_lead: SaaS ruulde walla On-premise e dow njuɓɓudi maa. Ko noon Fuɗɗorde, Njulaagu, Njaajeendi, e Platform tier. Sized ngam opitaaluuji e module, wonaa per-visit meeteer anxiété.
pricing_lead_cloud: Cloud ina jaɓɓoo Medora: SaaS keewɗo opitaal, kesɗitingol njuɓɓudi, e kuutorɗe renndinirɗe kala lowre nde njogiɗaa.
pricing_lead_onprem: On-premise ko tieruuji peewnugol gooti, joɗɗinaaɗi e toɗɗaaɗi e serweeji maa, e lowre maa, e lowre maa. Ko aan jeyi njuɓɓudi ndii. Doggol lewru ko Cloud + ${premium} ngam ndeen golle.
pricing_lead_mmk: Hollirde MMK e 1 USD = {rate} MMK ngam ƴeewndo nokku.
pricing_lead_usd: USD doggol cogguuji ngam kippuuji aduna.

pricing_who_lead: Platform, opitaal, gollotooɓe, e ñawɓe gooto fof ina heɓa laawol laaɓngol. Suɓo Cloud walla On-premise, ndeen tier gooto mo yahdata e no opitaaluuji e module dognirtaa.
pricing_who_platform_body: Operateeruuji aawdiiji opitaaluuji keewɗi e haajuuji white-label ɓeydi heen SSO. Suɓo Platform e dow Cloud walla e nder nokku.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Joom en e ardiiɓe konfiguraasiyoŋ branches, defte, jokkondire gollotooɓe, e jaagorgal. Business walla Scale ina yahdi e ko ɓuri heewde e pelle nokkuuji keewɗi.
pricing_who_staff_body: Infirmiyee en, safrooɓe, e kippuuji defte e dow module annduɓe darnde. Keeri jooɗorde njuuteendi e peeje; ñawɓe meeɗaa yiyde biro caggal.
pricing_who_patients_body: Karte, njilluuji, e binndanɗe ina keddii e safrirde ndee. Gollotooɓe ina kuutoroo gila e konsol e nder binnditagol rewrude e udditgol.
pricing_faq_q1: Mbele coggu nguu ko njillu walla ko jooɗorde gollotooɓe?
pricing_faq_a1: Tiers bayyinaaɗi ko kala fedde opitaal e cappanɗe opitaal e joɗnde. Cloud e On-premise ina ndennda Puɗɗorgal, Njulaagu, Njaajeendi, e Platform. Doggol lewru e nder nokku ko Cloud + $150. Alaa fof mbaadi huutortoo meeteer njillu kala ina ɓeydoo e ñalɗi golle.
pricing_faq_q2: Hol ko waɗi hitaande kala ina hisna 20%?
pricing_faq_a2: Faggudu hitaande kala ina jokki e hitaande teskaande Medora. SaaS opitaal mo Loomline ina heewi ustude peeje hitaande kala fotde 15 haa 20%. Medora ina huutoroo 20% e doggol lewru so a yoɓii hitaande kala, wonande Cloud e On-premise fof (caggal +$150 njoɓdi On-premise).
pricing_faq_q3: Mbele module innde e kilinik ina heen?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter ina waɗi binnditagol core, njilluuji, e nokkuuji gollorɗi kilinik e inndeeji baɗɗiiɗi. Njulaagu e ko ɓuri ɗum uddita golle timmuɗe, yamiroore leɗɗe jokkondirɗe e restoraaji, e konfiguraasiyoŋ admin ɓurɗo alɗude. Naamndo nde njiɗɗaa ɓeydooje regleteeɗe.
pricing_faq_a4: Huutoro toggol luumo dow peeje. Global hollirta ko USD tan. Miyanmar ina hollita MMK e 1 USD = 5000 MMK (e USD woni laana ɗiɗaɓa). Mudda facciro e mbaadi gollal ina ceerti e luumo.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud ina jaɓɓoo Medora: SaaS keewɗo opitaal, kesɗitingol njuɓɓudi, e fuɗɗoode ɓurnde yaawde. On-premise huutortoo ko tiers gooti, ​​joɗɗinaaɗi e infrastructure maa so aɗa yiɗi jogaade ɗowgol walla hoɗde. Infra ko maa; doggol lewru ko Cloud + $150 ngam ndeen golle.
pricing_trial_lead: Haalan min ko fayti e opitaaluuji mon e no foti waktuuji njiɗ-ɗon. Maa min njokku e email.
pricing_trial_message_placeholder: Lowre, ɓurnde heewde, Cloud walla ɓurannde e nder nokku...
pricing_trial_success: Ɗaɓɓaande ñaawoore heɓaama. Maa min njokku e email ko ɓooyaani.
pricing_trial_error_duration: Suɓo dumunna jarribo: balɗe 7, jonte 2, walla lewru 1.
pricing_trial_error_send: Waawaa neldude ɗaɓɓaande maa. Enndu kadi caggal.

admin_icd_subtitle: Browse WHO ICD-10, US ICD-10-CM, and WHO ICD-11 diagnosis codes used by EMR pickers. Each edition is a separate catalogue. Reseed imports the active tab (WHO ICD-API or CDC ICD-10-CM).
admin_icd_empty: No ICD codes match these filters.
admin_icd_reseed_confirm: Import the full catalogue for {system}? This can take a long time. Existing codes are upserted by code so diagnosis links stay valid. WHO editions need WHO_ICD_CLIENT_ID and WHO_ICD_CLIENT_SECRET. ICD-10-CM downloads from CDC.
admin_icd_reseed_success: ICD import finished. Inserted {inserted}, updated {updated}, total {total}.
admin_icd_reseed_hint: WHO tabs walk the WHO ICD-API (ICD-10 2019 / ICD-11 MMS). The ICD-10-CM tab imports CDC order files. Register WHO keys at https://icd.who.int/icdapi. CLI: pnpm db:import:icd -- --system ICD10|ICD11|ICD10_CM|WHO|ALL.
icd_cm_attribution: ICD-10-CM is the US clinical modification published by CDC/NCHS. It is stored as a separate catalogue from WHO ICD-10.
